philosophy: A high-trust, trauma-informed digital space. Must feel like a 'quiet room' — deeply empathetic, non-clinical, and institutional enough for parents/schools to trust it. The aesthetic is 'Nighttime Introspection': dark, safe, with soft moonlight accents.

headings.styling: tracking-tight, elegant, fluid scaling (max text-5xl or text-6xl). Never use bold (700+); rely on size and the font's natural elegance for hierarchy.
headings.usage: H1, H2, H3 and large quote text.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, small labels, navigation.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Use 2-3x standard spacing to create breathing room.
grids_and_layouts.bento_strategy: For 'Come Funziona' and 'Per le Scuole', use an asymmetrical Bento grid (Mode A) with wide gaps (gap-8).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs for readability. Center-align hero titles only if balanced.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Background: primary (#aabeff), Text: dark background (#0f0f0f). Soft hover state with scaling.
buttons.emergency: Pill-shaped, sticky bottom-right. High contrast warm red/terracotta to signal urgency without panic. Includes lucide-react 'Phone' or 'LifeBuoy' icon.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, border border-white/20, text-white/80. Hover: bg-white/5.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces (#161624) or extremely subtle glassmorphism. NO heavy drop shadows. Use 1px inner stroke (border-white/5) to separate from background. Border radius: rounded-2xl.

navigation.style: Sticky header with heavy backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#0f0f0f]/70. Ensure high contrast for links. Logo is text-based 'Spazio Sicuro' in Playfair Display.

accordion_faq.style: Minimalist. 1px bottom border on items. Use plus/minus icons. No box/card enclosure, just clean lines.

sections_and_content.content: Headline: 'Uno spazio dove respirare, senza giudizio.' Subtext explaining it's a free anonymous tool for teens to express emotions. CTA: 'Entra nello Spazio Sicuro'.
sections_and_content.layout: Massive top and bottom padding (py-32). Deep dark background. Potential slow, subtle background mesh using primary color at 5% opacity.

sections_and_content.content: Why this exists. Emphasize silence, respect, absence of tracking.
sections_and_content.layout: Editorial text layout. Huge 'Playfair Display' drop-quotes. Asymmetrical overlapping with a calm imagery.
Bento grid. Use Lucide icons (PenLine, Palette, Mic, Wind) with soft primary-tinted backgrounds.

sections_and_content.content: Reassurance sections. Highlight privacy, psychological safety, and prevention.
sections_and_content.layout: Side-by-side or alternating large blocks. Use silhouette image of parent/teen.

sections_and_content.content: 'Zero Cookie. Zero Tracciamento. Zero Dati Salvati.'
sections_and_content.layout: Brutalist typographic impact. Center aligned, massive text size (text-5xl), extremely minimal to convey absolute transparency.
Visually distinct container (perhaps dark gray with subtle red tint border) so it stands out immediately for anyone in crisis.
Standard Shadcn Accordion, narrow max-width (max-w-3xl) for readability.
Clean Shadcn Form components on a surface card.

hero_or_manifesto.description: Calm body of water under a full moon. Represents the calm, non-judgmental space.
hero_or_manifesto.usage: Background overlay with heavy black tint, or side image in Manifesto.

quiet_room.description: A quiet empty room with soft window light. Represents 'Spazio' (The Room).
quiet_room.usage: Editorial image alongside the 'Come funziona' or 'Manifesto' sections.

parents_section.usage: Visual anchor for the 'Per i Genitori' section.

motion.philosophy: Trauma-informed motion. Zero erratic, bouncy, or fast animations. Everything must feel like deep breathing.
rules: Use framer-motion for extremely slow, soft fade-ins on scroll (duration 0.8s to 1.2s).
Hover states should cross-fade colors smoothly, not snap.
No auto-playing videos. Avoid aggressive parallax.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA. Verify text colors against #0f0f0f background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='cta-hero-button'.
accessibility.language: Italian language everywhere. Use empathetic, non-triggering microcopy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons. NO EMOJIS.
Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Set up fonts Playfair Display and Manrope via @fontsource or Google Fonts in index.css.
Ensure the floating 'Ho bisogno d'aiuto ora' button is always accessible on mobile and desktop.

Avoid Shadcn Cards if they look too 'SaaS-like' and rigid. Use custom raw HTML/Tailwind divs with padding (p-8/p-12), solid colors (#161624), and 1px borders to make it look editorial and architectural rather than like a generic dashboard.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown menus. Ensure Nav/mobile menu has a solid or heavily blurred dark background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. NEVER center align the app container. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use lucide-react. Every interaction needs a micro-animation. Ensure all 'data-testid' attributes are placed on buttons and links.
